evals.name: shazamkit-managed-session-listening
evals.prompt: Implement an audio recognition service in Swift using ShazamKit's SHManagedSession on iOS 17+, handling the results async sequence to extract matched song title and artist.
evals.expected_output: A Swift class or actor initializing SHManagedSession, iterating over session.results, and handling .match and .noMatch enum cases.
assertions: Instantiates SHManagedSession for ambient audio recognition.
Iterates over session.results using for-await-in async stream.
Handles .match case and extracts SHMatchedMediaItem details like title and artist.
Provides cancellation with session.cancel() when stopping recognition.

evals.name: shazamkit-custom-catalog-creation
evals.prompt: Write a Swift service that creates an SHCustomCatalog, adds reference signatures with custom SHMediaItem metadata, and exports the catalog to a .shazamcatalog file.
evals.expected_output: Code initializing SHCustomCatalog, calling addReferenceSignature(_:representing:), and exporting with catalog.write(to:).
assertions: Creates SHMediaItem with custom properties like .title and .artist.
Exports the catalog using catalog.write(to: fileURL).

evals.name: shazamkit-microphone-stream-matching
evals.prompt: Show how to set up an AVAudioEngine input tap that streams audio PCM buffers into an SHSession with SHSessionDelegate to perform continuous recognition.
evals.expected_output: Code attaching an audio tap to engine.inputNode, passing buffers to session.matchStreamingBuffer(_:at:), and implementing SHSessionDelegate.
assertions: Instantiates an SHSession and assigns an SHSessionDelegate.
Installs an audio tap on engine.inputNode to capture PCM buffers.
Forwards buffers using session.matchStreamingBuffer(buffer, at: audioTime).
Implements session(_:didFind:) and session(_:didNotFindMatchFor:error:) delegate methods.

evals.name: shazamkit-offline-signature-generation
evals.prompt: Demonstrate how to convert an audio file into an SHSignature using SHSignatureGenerator without sending raw audio across the network.
evals.expected_output: Code reading audio file buffers into SHSignatureGenerator and calling signature() to produce an SHSignature.
assertions: Reads audio buffers using AVAudioFile and appends them via generator.append(_:at:).
Generates the final signature by calling generator.signature().
Mentions or handles format requirements for audio PCM buffers.
